action.name: 🌌 Open in Garchy Terminal
action.description: Open Kitty terminal in the current directory

action.name: 💻 Open with VS Code
action.description: Open selected files or directories in VS Code

action.name: 🤖 Inspect with Cephalon AI
action.description: Have Cephalon AI inspect, explain, or diagnose this file

action.name: 📦 Compress to High-Speed .tar.zst
action.command: kitty --title "ZSTD Archiver" sh -c "echo 'Compressing %N with multi-threaded ZSTD...'; tar --zstd -cf '%n.tar.zst' %N && echo '✔ Archive created: %n.tar.zst' && sleep 1.5"
action.description: Create an ultra-fast ZSTD compressed archive

action.name: 🔒 Verify SHA256 Checksum
action.command: kitty --title "SHA256 Checksum" sh -c "echo 'Calculating SHA256 Checksum for %n:'; sha256sum %N; echo ''; read -p 'Press Enter to close...'"

action.name: 🌌 Set as SDDM Login Wallpaper
action.description: Set the selected image as the Garchy OS SDDM Login Screen background
